description: Loose waves falling just past the shoulders, a few soft strands framing the face on either side.
Twin braids beginning at the crown and draping over both shoulders, tied off at the ends with small neat knots.
A high ponytail pulled tight at the crown, the length cascading down in a smooth, swaying fall past the shoulder blades.
Hair loosely gathered into a low bun at the nape, several wispy strands escaping around the ears and forehead.
A short, tousled crop sitting close to the head, windswept and slightly uneven, with one lock dipping across the forehead.
Shoulder-length hair worn mostly loose, with one side neatly tucked behind the ear and the other falling forward.
A messy top-knot balanced high on the head, strands jutting out at odd angles and a loose tendril curling at the temple.
A neat side part with hair lying flat and close on one side, slightly fuller and swept across on the other.
A single long braid draped over one shoulder, woven tightly at the crown and gradually loosening toward the tip.
Curly, voluminous hair that springs outward from the head, dense and full, the ringlets falling just past the chin on all sides.
Twin braids starting at the crown and draping over the front of each shoulder, tied off with small bows.
A high ponytail pulled taut at the crown, the length cascading in a gentle wave down the back.
Hair gathered into a low bun at the nape, slightly messy, with a few loose strands curling free around the ears.
A short, tousled crop, slightly windswept and uneven, with a single wayward lock dipping over the forehead.
Shoulder-length hair tucked neatly behind one ear, the other side left to fall softly across the cheek.
A messy top-knot perched loosely at the crown, shorter pieces escaping at the temples and the nape.
A neat side part with the longer top swept cleanly to one side and the sides kept close and flat.
A single long braid draped over one shoulder, reaching past the collarbone, with a few wispy strands left loose at the hairline.
Short and windswept all over, the textured ends pushed in several directions as if caught mid-gust.
